note: S=選んで受け入れる・受け入れない物を処分/断ると書く、P=送る前の連絡・申し出が必要、N=寄贈を受け付けない、U=条件の記載なし、scope=自国に関係する資料に限る。2026-10-21 に開いた頁の表示どおりに分類。標本は国立・州立の図書館で無作為ではない（ISL は 'disposed' を含む検索で見つけた）。

libs.name: Library of Congress
libs.quote: cannot accept everything. Prospective donors should NOT send the item(s), but instead, send gift offers

libs.name: National Library of Australia
libs.quote: Please do not send or bring objects or items to the Library ... We only accept items that align with our Collection Development Policy

libs.name: 国立国会図書館
libs.quote: 当館が蔵書としない資料は、原則として廃棄します ... リストの送付がないまま資料が送付された場合、蔵書としないと判断する場合があります

libs.name: Library and Archives Canada
libs.quote: Please contact us before mailing any material. ... If your material is not accepted for our collection, it will not be returned

libs.name: National Library of Scotland
libs.quote: please contact us before sending anything in ... we may dispose of donations that do not meet our Collection Development Policy

libs.name: National Library of Ireland
libs.quote: considerations ... taken into account when accepting or declining donations ... The Library does not collect duplicates

libs.name: Indiana State Library
libs.quote: Selectivity is crucial ... If a gift is not added, the State Library will exercise the right to offer it to another library or otherwise dispose of the item.

libs.name: British Library
libs.quote: please take a look at our acquisitions policy here or contact Customer Services ... for more information
